notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Important Notes[/b][/h1]

1. Due to the compatibility-breaking changes in Floating Castle level, any player progress in this level will be lost after this update. All other levels are unaffected. We are very sorry for the inconvenience.

2. Based on the feedback from our players, we decided to remove all AI enemies which are not tied to puzzle solving. However, to keep the enemy related achievements accessible, we put them into the secret room level.

We made these changes only to deliver a better gaming experience. Your satisfaction is always our biggest drive to move forward.

Here's a complete list of changes and bug fixes:

[b]Changes[/b]

-Refined tutorial contents in Floating Castle
-Removed AI enemies which are not tied to puzzle solving. Keep a few of them in the secret room level
-The character won't be able to jump on a steep slope
-Slightly changed the angle of character fast turning
-Increased the size of big iron boxes to prevent the character from jumping onto them directly
-Added collapse damage detection for a platform in Magma Ruin
-The box near the double elevators in Sea Tower Part 1 won't be climbable

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

-Make sure the character and camera status is reset when reloading a scene
-The fade out effect after the character has fallen won't block the pause menu
-Fixed a bug in Floating Castle that caused the placed swords on the first fan blades to be floating in the air
-Fixed a physical collision issue of the second slingshot platform in Huge Woods
-Fixed the character alignment with the plant column when climbing it in Huge Woods
-Fixed some control issues of the double box puzzle in Magma Ruin
-Fixed an issue that caused the camera movement to be too sensitive when the character is on an elevator in Sea Tower
-Fixed a bug in Stars Lake that may cause the character to be irresponsive for several seconds after a cutscene is played

notes.title: Dreamlike platformer Incredible Mandy comes to Steam with a free demo
notes.notes:
Incredible Mandy is a lovely looking platformer-adventure about the dreams of a brother and sister, who must unlock the memories they hide following a tragic accident. Left without his hand as a result of the trauma, Mandy's brother can manifest the Excalibur of Light in its place, a "symbol of positive power" he wields as he journeys through strange, beautiful dream worlds under the guidance of his sister. 

That is an undeniably vague description, and you won't find a whole lot more on Steam. "From mountain peaks to deep canyons, from sea shores to hidden corridors, search for clues and solve innovative puzzles; use the sword in your hand and the wisdom of your mind to challenge overwhelming foes," the list states. "Can you pierce through the mist of dreams and discover the unexpected truth?" 

The lack of clarity is made up for to a large extent by the presence of a downloadable demo, so you can grab it and try it risk-and-hassle-free even if you're only a little curious about what's going on. I've played with it a bit—not far enough to get into the underlying themes of loss and recovery, but enough to sample the systems and get eyes on the game world—and it looks very promising. 

Do note that progress from the demo will not carry over to the full game: developer Dotoyou said that there are differences in the content and the order it's introduced, so that keeping save games is impossible. The full game will have eight unique chapters, each with a puzzle level and boss fight, and if you're more into exploration than extermination an explorer mode option promises to greatly simplify combat so you can focus on sightseeing. 

Incredible Mandy isn't actually live on Steam just yet, but it's slated to happen today.

Bug fixes

notes.title: Incredible Mandy PC Demo Available for Download on Steam
notes.notes:
Today we're very excited to announce that Incredible Mandy PC demo is available for download on Steam.

We wish you a fantastic trip in this freshly-built demo version, and give a first glance at the mysterious game world. If you like it don't forget to add it to your wishlist and follow our game updates. Please feel free to leave comments below and post in the community forum. We're looking forward to your feedback.
